questions.q: A ligament is damaged when an ankle is twisted. This injury is a
questions.why: Sprains are ligament injuries; strains involve muscle or tendon.

questions.q: Which drug is most likely to be used by an archer to steady the hands?
questions.why: Beta blockers slow the heart and reduce tremor.

questions.q: Which is a risk of taking EPO?
questions.why: EPO thickens the blood, raising the risk of clots, stroke and heart attack.

questions.q: Give two reasons why a cool-down is important after exercise.
questions.model: It keeps blood flowing to remove waste products such as lactic acid. It lowers heart rate gradually and reduces muscle soreness.
points: gradually lowers heart rate / reduces soreness
